verdict.rationale: Kimi offers a model API (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible Kimi Code API with console-managed keys), but nothing shows the UI's capabilities are exposed through it. Features such as PPT assistant, deep research, scheduled tasks, agent clusters, webpage building and Kimi Claw have no documented API equivalents. A probe also found no public API for the assistant app itself; the Open Platform API is a separate product. An inference API is an adjacent building block, not UI–API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
